Not a consumer graduation: SAFE_COMPATIBLE is not claimed; element 7 status comes from the closure run, not from this receipt.
Not a constant-time, cryptographic or compatibility result.

The negative controls exercise public entry paths; they do not prove the absence of other callers outside this crate (C callers of X509V3_EXT_nconf, UI_method_set_ex_data, ENGINE_set_ex_data). Those remain external ABI obligations where the authority has the same shape.
